action.name: execute
action.description: Executes a bounded HTTP request to an allowed host. Supply confirmed=true to operation_execute; non-HTTP providers currently return an unsupported outcome.

argument.name: protocol
argument.description: Use http for supported execution; grpc, kafka, and custom are recognized but unsupported providers.

argument.name: request
argument.description: For http: method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, or OPTIONS) and absolute url on an allowed host are required. Optional headers map string names to string values; body accepts a non-blank string, object, or array; timeoutMs is an integer from 1 to 300000. CDE bounds the complete arguments JSON to 1048576 bytes and each string to 262144 UTF-8 bytes, so HTTP body capacity through CDE is lower than the provider's 4 MiB ceiling.

argument.name: options
argument.description: wrappedOnly defaults to true and rejects execution when the probe registry allows non-wrapped executables.
